src/common/helpers/escape-like.ts.reason: Verified: the unit test checks the character replacement itself, int:doctor checks that %, _ and \ in searchFor are matched as plain text in Postgres. These are different levels, not a duplicate.

src/common/helpers/pagination/paginate.t.reason: Verified: the arithmetic (skip/offset, lastPage, edge cases) is checked only in paginate.spec.ts. Integration tests check skip/take and limit/offset behavior with join and groupBy (pages do not overlap, count is correct). e2e tests check only the response shape.

src/common/helpers/pagination/paginated-.reason: Query validation DTO, goes through HTTP in e2e.
Infrastructure: response DTO, executed when any controller loads, needs no direct checks.

src/common/helpers/safe-repository.provi.reason: Infrastructure: repository provider, all DB queries go through it, needs no direct checks.

src/common/helpers/get-entity-repository.reason: Infrastructure: repository getter, all DB queries go through it, needs no direct checks.

src/common/helpers/clinic-time.ts.reason: Verified: the semantics (time zone, daylight saving time, independence from the process TZ) are checked only in clinic-time.spec.ts. In the other tests the helper is used as a dependency: booking-rules.spec checks the booking window, appointment.service.spec checks that the service takes the center time zone, int:appointment and e2e:appointments go through it while preparing data and do not check the window itself.

src/domain/appointment/helpers/booking-r.reason: Verified: the booking window and slot ownership rules are checked by booking-rules.spec.ts. appointment.service.spec checks that the rules are wired into create and reschedule (see the report note about the repeated boundary value 16:59:59). int:appointment and e2e:appointments do not check the rules: the booking window is not tested in them, and the PAST/FUTURE calculation in int:appointment goes through SQL (AT TIME ZONE), not through this helper.

src/common/helpers/decorators/not-unique.reason: Verified: NotUniqueErrorMetadata is applied when entities load (infrastructure). getNotUniqueErrorText is executed by int:users and int:appointment via DatabaseEntityUniqueConstraintError, but on different entities and different constraints (phone and nickname versus a taken slot). The message text is checked only by int:appointment.
